name: Watershed-based Morse-Smale Approximation
aliases: Morse-Smale complex approximation via watershed segmentation
flow-based analysis for protein surface segmentation
definition: Approximates the discrete Morse-Smale complex by intersecting watershed segmentations of a scalar field and its complement, avoiding explicit critical point extraction.
summary: Watershed-based Morse-Smale Approximation partitions surfaces into monotonic regions by intersecting watershed segmentations of a scalar field and its complement, avoiding explicit critical point extraction.
